subject: Certification checklist & retention sprint — Nova Insight MAP
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lina Cho <lina.cho@nova-insight.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Certification checklist & retention sprint — Nova Insight MAP

Hi Lina —

Thanks for the call this morning. Per our discussion I've pulled together the initial certification checklist we'd like to include in the mutual action plan (MAP) so we can align on what constitutes "security acceptance" for the POC and production roll. High-level asks below — I've attached a SIG/CAIQ template we filled out with the initial answers and a draft DPA with our typical retention clauses.

Top items for MAP / acceptance cadence:
- SOC 2 status: customer needs either SOC 2 Type II report (last 12 months) or agreed compensating controls and schedule for Type II delivery.
- SIG/CAIQ: we shared a completed draft; please confirm open items and any evidence you can provide.
- DPA redlines: retention windows (request: 90/180/365 options) + residency (US-only vs EU residency carveout).
- Evidence handoff: secure SFTP or SOC evidence package (zip stub) by milestone dates below.

Proposed timeline (flexible):
- 9/29: SIG/CAIQ reconciliation meeting (30m) to go through open cells.
- 10/06: Legal sends DPA redlines back to Redwood (we can review and surface must-haves).
- 10/13: Evidence sprint — initial evidence package delivered to our security engineers.
- 10/20: Acceptance decision / canary approval (limited prod tokens)

Are you ok with the timeline above? If Nova requires more time for legal review we can compress the evidence sprint and keep the acceptance gated on the SOC 2 path.

Attachments: sig_caiq-v1.xlsx, dpa_redline_v3.docx

Thanks — I can host the SIG reconciliation/triage on 9/29 at 10am PT if that works.

Cheers,
Stephanie Nguyen
Solutions Engineering Lead
Redwood Inference

--

From: Lina Cho <lina.cho@nova-insight.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Nova Insight Security <security@nova-insight.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Sep 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Certification checklist & retention sprint — Nova Insight MAP

Stephanie —

Appreciate the clear breakdown. We're aligned on the process and the dates mostly look good. Quick notes from security/legal side:

- I attached a completed SIG/CAIQ export (see column "evidence_available"). A few items will need short writeups (cross-team).
- SOC 2: we have a SOC 2 Type II in progress; expected report delivery 2027-11-10. For the POC/canary we can provide our Type II interim control evidence and an attestation letter from our auditor. Is that acceptable for the 10/20 limited prod?
- DPA/retention: our legal prefers 365 days as standard retention for log-level artifacts; product team is pushing 180 days for cost. We can propose a tiered model in the DPA: 90 days (default), 365 days (enterprise opt-in), and an EU residency addendum if you require it.

Attachments: sig_caiq-export.xlsx, evidence_manifest.csv (stub)

I'll join the SIG reconciliation on 9/29. For DPA redlines we'll aim to send initial comments by 10/04, legal permitting.

Best,
Lina Cho
Head of IT Risk & Compliance
Nova Insight

--

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 24 Sep 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Certification checklist & retention sprint — Nova Insight MAP

Steph / Marcus —

Small internal alignment before the SIG call. Notes / suggested positions for DPA & retention: 

- Position: accept interim SOC 2 artifacts + auditor attestation for canary only, but require full SOC 2 Type II before general availability (GA). Put this in the MAP acceptance criteria.
- Retention: push for 90 days for logs by default in the DPA, with an enterprise tier at 365 days. If Nova insists on 365 as default, ask for cost-sharing language or a commitment to reserved capacity for long-retention exports.
- EU residency: require an addendum (data residency SLA) rather than a single-line carveout in the DPA. We should map the operational impact (where backups live, support access) and include that in the MAP.
- Evidence modality: request a secure evidence package (evidence_package.zip) via SFTP link + MD5 checksum. Our security team will run a quick ingest check and then open the acceptance ticket.

Action items for call:
1) Confirm SIG rows that are blockers vs informational (I'll mark 6 rows as blockers to start).
2) Get Lina to commit to DPA baseline timeline — if 10/04 hits legal, we push our review to 10/06 and provide consolidated comments.
3) Confirm who on Nova will be responsible for evidence upload (request contact).

I'll be on the 9/29 10am PT slot and will bring a short checklist to walk through.

-Kim
Head of Security Programs
Redwood Inference

--

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lina Cho <lina.cho@nova-insight.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 24 Sep 2027 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Certification checklist & retention sprint — Nova Insight MAP

Thanks all — solid plan. Quick summary and mutual action items so we have a single source of truth in the thread before the SIG call: 

Mutual Action Plan (summary):
- 9/29 10:00am PT: SIG/CAIQ reconciliation (owner: Stephanie).
- By 10/04: Nova sends initial DPA redlines (owner: Nova legal — Lina).
- By 10/06: Redwood returns consolidated DPA comments + retention options (owner: Redwood legal — Stephanie / contracts).
- 10/13: Evidence sprint — Nova uploads evidence_package.zip to SFTP (owner: Nova operations).
- 10/20: Canary acceptance decision (owner: Joint security review) — acceptance gated on interim SOC artifacts + SIG reconciliations being closed or mitigated.

DPA / retention stances (agreed next steps):
- Redwood preference: 90 days default, 365 opt-in. If Nova requires 365 default, they should indicate cost uptake or reserved capacity in the MAP.
- EU residency: Nova to provide an addendum draft outlining where data will be hosted and backups reside; Redwood to estimate changes to access and support flows.

Attachments & links referenced:
- sig_caiq-v1.xlsx (Redwood filled)
- dpa_redline_v3.docx (Redwood starting draft)
- sig_caiq-export.xlsx (Nova response)
- evidence_package.zip (to be uploaded on 10/13)
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/8742
- DocuSign DPA template (placeholder): https://www.docusign.com/templates/dpa-8742

Please reply-all with confirmations or exceptions. If there are no blockers we'll run the SIG triage tomorrow and capture the open items into the MAP board.

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
Solutions Engineering Lead
Redwood Inference
